headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy affair scandal and lawsuits
summary: Congress summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia opened an investigation, lawsuits followed, and further affairs were later reported. Huang resigned as CEO, Colette Kress became interim chief, and one report put Nvidia's market value loss at over $1 trillion within a month.

claims.statement: Congress summoned Jensen Huang over concerns about Chinese espionage tied to his relationship with a suspected intelligence operative.

sources.quote: Lawmakers want answers about Jensen Huang’s ties to an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
Nvidia's Jensen Huang officially called to Congress due to reports of a Chinese spy plot

claims.statement: China's intelligence agency was reported to have recruited a Megaspeed executive to spy on Huang.

sources.quote: China's intelligence agency recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
China's main intelligence agency reportedly recruited the spy who targeted NVIDIA's CEO

claims.statement: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into Huang's relationship with the suspected spy.

sources.quote: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence
Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy

claims.statement: Huang acknowledged the affair in a memo to Nvidia employees.

sources.quote: Huang sent a memo to Nvidia employees acknowledging the affair
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy

claims.statement: At the time, Nvidia's board said it remained confident in Huang and the leadership team.

sources.quote: claims it is still confident in Jensen and leadership team

claims.statement: Huang was summoned to testify before a congressional committee over the affair.

sources.quote: Jensen Huang has been summoned to appear before Congress's Select Committee on the CCP.
Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair

claims.statement: Nvidia's stock price fell sharply after news of the investigation, wiping hundreds of billions of dollars from its value.

sources.quote: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.
Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation

claims.statement: Shareholders and a law firm filed lawsuits against Nvidia and Huang over the affair.

sources.quote: Law firm files class-action lawsuit against Nvidia after CEO Jensen Huang confirms affair with alleged Chinese spy
NVIDIA shareholders are suing the company and CEO Jensen Huang

claims.statement: Reports later said Huang had a second affair, with an Nvidia executive who reported to him, with an alleged cover-up attempt.

sources.quote: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly had an extramarital affair with a direct report, following a separate affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

claims.statement: Following the second affair report, Nvidia's board was said to be preparing to remove Huang as CEO.

sources.quote: Nvidia's board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a report from the New York Times about a second alleged extramarital affair
Nvidia’s Board reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang as second extra-marital affair emerges

claims.statement: Nvidia announced Huang's resignation as CEO, citing the two affairs.

sources.quote: Nvidia's board has separated from Jensen Huang, its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO, after reports of two extramarital affairs
Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO

claims.statement: Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO following Huang's departure.

sources.quote: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang resigns, chipmaker names CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO

claims.statement: President Trump suggested Apple CEO Tim Cook as a possible successor to Huang.

sources.quote: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.

claims.statement: A further report said Huang was having a third affair, with another Nvidia employee.

sources.quote: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports

claims.statement: Huang agreed to testify before Congress after lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.

sources.quote: agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him

claims.statement: Some tech industry figures criticized the resignation, calling it a mistake, while others continued to defend Huang.

sources.quote: ‘It’s a mistake’: reactions from tech leaders on Jensen Huang’s resignation
Silicon Valley Is Still Defending Jensen Huang

claims.statement: One report said Nvidia's market value had lost more than $1 trillion in less than a month since the scandal began.

sources.quote: More Than $1 Trillion on Fire in Less Than a Month

claims.statement: One report said Huang described himself in crude terms after what it called his forced departure from the company.

sources.quote: after his forced departure

discrepancies.explanation: Most headlines describe Huang's exit as a resignation, while one report frames it as a forced departure during which he reportedly surrendered.

quotes.quote: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO

discrepancies.explanation: An early report measured Nvidia's stock drop in the hundreds of billions of dollars, while a report weeks into the scandal put the cumulative market-value loss at more than $1 trillion.

quotes.quote: More Than $1 Trillion on Fire in Less Than a Month
